conviction_note: Findings sum to +1.0 (a ~$23.5M litigation-accrual reversal that should flatter Q3 GAAP EPS against a one-estimate -$2.10 bar, a likely small revenue beat inside a guide the company beat by $3.8M last quarter, a mechanical gross-margin step-up, a ~31%-of-shares short) against a convertible-exchange overhang and continuing US/foodservice declines. The scaled number is negative (p_up 45 x abs 15 = -1.5) because the reaction function vetoes the fundamental read: 8 of 8 prior prints fell (median |10.3%|), including -13.4% on a Q2 that beat revenue consensus by ~10% and carried an $11M one-off credit. The upside-paid skew (-8.4 vol pts) and the crowded short keep p_up from going lower.
bar: Q3 2026 net revenue: company guide ~$60-65M (Q2 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001655210/000165521026000053/ex991pressrelease-q22026ea.htm, 2026-08-05); consensus ~$63.7-64.0M from two agreeing sources (Benzinga https://www.benzinga.com/quote/BYND/earnings-forecasts $63.7-63.9M; Earnings Whispers https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/bynd $63.71M). EPS bar -$2.02 to -$2.10 rests on ONE estimate (Earnings Whispers) and is treated as unreliable. Revenue bar is sourced; the consensus sits inside the guided range, just below its top.
positioning_check: Short interest ~5.70M shares (5,696,198) at the 2026-09-30 settlement, ~1.63M shares avg daily volume, 3.5 days to cover (https://altindex.com/ticker/bynd/short-interest and https://massive.com/quote/bynd, both dated settlement 2026-09-30). Against ~18.4M shares outstanding (implied by Millennium's 13G: 957,442 shares = 5.2%, event 2026-09-21, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1655210/000110465926111444/primary_doc.xml) that is ~31% of shares. Borrow fee 64.4% annualised and 25.6% SI per Tapeboard on 2026-08-17 (https://tapeboard.com/most-shorted-stocks/2026-08-17); no newer borrow figure found. Baseline: event implied move 15.81%, 25d skew -8.43 vol pts (calls richer than puts: upside paid), put/call OI 0.34, spot $7.43, -82% from 52w high, 20d run-up -3.0%, 5d +4.2%. Crowded short plus call-skew is a squeeze mechanism; yet all 8 prior reactions were negative.

findings.finding: The company carried a $38.9M accrued litigation liability for the Sonate/Vegadelphia trademark case unchanged at 2026-06-27 (10-Q balance sheet), and on 2026-09-18, inside fiscal Q3 (ended 2026-09-26), the court entered judgment of only $15,437,500 (actual damages cut from $23.5M to $37,500, disgorgement $15.4M kept), so Q3 GAAP opex should carry a reversal of roughly $23.5M. Against a Q2 operating loss of $30.8M and ~18.4M post-split shares, that is roughly +$1.25/share against a single-estimate consensus EPS of -$2.10, i.e. a headline GAAP EPS 'beat' most screens will show.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 carried an $11.0M arbitration-settlement credit in opex and a $57.7M debt-extinguishment gain giving positive net income; the stock fell 13.44% (baseline, 2026-08-05). One-off credits have not been paid on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The ruling itself is public (8-K 2026-09-22; Green Queen 2026-09-23) and the stock has sat near $7.2-7.4 since, so the liability cut is likely priced as value. What is not visibly priced is the EPS presentation: the only EPS estimate (-$2.10) looks like a run-rate loss with no reversal; if it were priced the estimate would be near -$0.8 to -$0.9. Retail-heavy flow and headline algos react to GAAP EPS. The company could also hold part of the accrual pending appeal, which caps this.
findings.independence: Accrual balance from the Q2 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001655210/000165521026000055/bynd-20260627.htm, accrued litigation $38,900K at 2026-06-27 and 2025-12-31); judgment amount corroborated by Green Queen 2026-09-23 (https://www.greenqueen.com.hk/?p=88668). Same underlying fact, so one finding.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue is likely to land at or slightly above the top of the $60-65M guide: the company guided Q2 to the same $60-65M and printed $68.8M (+$3.8M over the top; ~+10% vs a ~$62.5M consensus); applying last year's Q2-to-Q3 seasonal ratio (Q3'25 $70.2M / Q2'25 $75.0M = 0.936) to Q2'26 $68.8M gives ~$64.4M, and international retail (+16.5% in Q2, Europe/UK/Canada) is supported by Oatly's Q3 print showing accelerating Europe & International growth. Bar ~$63.8M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue beat consensus by ~10% and beat the top of the guide; stock -13.44%. Q1 2026 was reported as a sales miss and the stock dropped (-14.13% on 2026-05-06). Revenue beats are sold on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus ($63.7-64.0M) sits inside the guide, not above it, so a repeat of the Q2 pattern ($3-4M over the top) is not in the estimates. If it were priced, consensus would sit at or above $65M. But the guide has been conservative twice and buyers know it, and the reaction history says it does not matter.
findings.independence: Oatly Q3 2026 (6-K, 2026-10-28): revenue +9.1% with accelerating Europe & International growth (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001843586/000184358626000027/otly-ex99_1.htm). Different category (oat dairy alternative), so a proxy only. Seasonal arithmetic uses the same company release.

findings.finding: Balance-sheet repair is being paid for in shares, and the overhang sits at today's price: on 2026-09-23 the company exchanged ~$15.0M of 0% 2027 Notes at 96% of face for stock priced off a 3-day VWAP with a $7.4009 floor (up to 1,945,709 shares, ~11% of the ~17.2M post-split shares outstanding at 2026-08-05), after amending the 2030 indenture on 2026-08-10 to permit further 2027 repurchases/exchanges for equity. The company can no longer use Form S-3 or its ATM (Q2 release), 2027 Notes of ~$29.5M carrying value were current at Q2 (about half now exchanged), and 2030 Notes (7% PIK, carrying $208.7M) keep converting. What the money buys: deleveraging, not a growth ramp; cash was $186.1M with ~$18M quarterly operating burn, no going-concern language found. Last year's Q3 print came with a new securities offering.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 print (2025-11-10, -8.96%) was accompanied by a proposed new securities offering and dilution fears (https://rallies.ai/news/beyond-meat-q3-sales-fall-133-and-december-dilution-fears-trigger-17-drop); the October 2025 exchange window coincided with the -23.06% reaction on 2025-10-24.
findings.why_not_priced: The exchanges are disclosed, so the dilution done is priced. What is not is the next step: with the 2030 indenture now permitting more 2027 exchanges and no S-3/ATM, a Q3 release or 10-Q that discloses further exchanges, conversions or a new equity route would hit a stock that has floored near the $7.40 exchange price. If the market priced that, the stock would trade below the exchange floor rather than at it. Shrunk because ~31% of shares are short and calls are bid (squeeze mechanism), and because the financing reduces debt rather than signalling distress.
findings.independence: Indenture amendment 8-K 2026-08-10 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001655210/000119312526341312/d156122d8k.htm) and 7.01 8-K 2026-07-17 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1655210/000119312526308001/d57467d8k.htm) disclosing the consent solicitation; S-3/ATM ineligibility and share count from the Q2 release. All company documents, one financing thread, filed as one finding.

findings.finding: Positioning: ~5.70M shares short at the 2026-09-30 settlement (3.5 days to cover), roughly 31% of ~18.4M shares outstanding; borrow at 64.4% annualised in August; options price upside (25d skew -8.43 vol pts, put/call OI 0.34); and Millennium disclosed a 5.2% long (957,442 shares, event 2026-09-21), likely tied to the convertible exchange. A tolerable print on a GAAP-EPS-flattering quarter meets a crowded short.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short interest has been high (25-30%+ of float) through all of 2026 and every one of the last 8 prints fell (-4.1% to -23.1%); the October 2025 squeeze happened outside a print. Positioning has not saved a print on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the call skew already pays for upside. Filed because it is the mechanism by which a non-bad print can produce an outsized up move on a ~$137M market cap with ~1M shares a day of turnover; if the squeeze risk were fully priced the straddle would sit well above the 15.8% event move given 31% of shares short.
findings.independence: Massive.com same settlement (https://massive.com/quote/bynd); Tapeboard 2026-08-17 borrow fee 64.4% (https://tapeboard.com/most-shorted-stocks/2026-08-17); Millennium 13G (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1655210/000110465926111444/primary_doc.xml); skew from sealed baseline.

findings.finding: Gross margin should step up mechanically in Q3: management said on the Q2 call that Q2 carried the last of the accelerated-depreciation drag (more than 2 points of margin) plus $1.6M of China-cessation costs (~2.3 points) inside an 8.5% gross margin, and opex fell 15% sequentially, so Q3 gross margin in the low-to-mid teens and a narrower adjusted EBITDA loss (Q2 -$27.7M) are telegraphed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 opex fell to $36.7M from $45.4M and operating cash use fell 44%; the stock still fell 13.44%. Cost progress has not been paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Told to the market by management, so largely expected; the residual is that the lone EPS estimate (-$2.10, ~-$38M) looks like it embeds little margin improvement. Lower volume (Q2 -9.5%) still hurts absorption, which management named as the main lever.
findings.independence: Q2 release shows the $1.6M China wind-down cost inside gross profit (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001655210/000165521026000053/ex991pressrelease-q22026ea.htm). Same company, different document.

findings.finding: The US and foodservice lines keep shrinking with no corroborated turn: Q2 US retail -9.9% (volume -5.7%, fewer points of distribution), US foodservice -27.6%, international foodservice -16.0% on lower QSR sales in Europe and Canada; management cited weak category demand. No 2026 Circana/Nielsen plant-based meat series was found to show a turn. New US distribution (Steak Filet at Sprouts, 2026-10-29; Beyond Immerse drink, 2026-10-15) lands in Q4, not Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Declining US volume has accompanied every negative reaction in the baseline (Q4 2025 -19.7% revenue, Q1 2026 -15.3%).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the guide already implies -7% to -15% YoY. The residual is commentary on Q4 and on US distribution losses, which have twice been the line the stock sold on. Net of the rest: international retail (27% of Q2 revenue) grew 16.5% and is the offset, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: Category decline (refrigerated in freefall, frozen plateauing) per Circana via AgFunderNews (https://agfundernews.com/plant-based-meat-us-retail-refrigerated-remains-in-freefall-frozen-starting-to-plateau); date not re-verified on the page, so it is context only.

outside_window.finding: Remaining 0% 2027 Notes (~$14.5M principal after the September exchange of ~$15.0M from ~$29.5M carrying value) mature in 2027; further exchanges for equity are now permitted by the 2030 indenture amendment. Their dilution or cash repayment resolves after the window unless disclosed with the print.
The Sonate/Vegadelphia judgment can still be appealed by either side; an appeal outcome that changes the $15.4M judgment resolves long after the window.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive and agree with the upside-paid skew and the crowded short, but they cut against the name's own reaction history (0 of 8 prints up, beats and one-off credits both sold), which is why the scaled number is negative while the findings sum is positive.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction; the Q2 revenue beat was sold -13.4%): revenue-beat finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3; p_up stays at 45.
Lesson 2 vs lesson 8 on the litigation reversal: it sits in opex (above operating income) and the EPS bar is one estimate, so the one-off discount and the thin-coverage uplift offset; left at +0.8.

Lesson 4 + 7 (financing is a question; crowded short shrinks negatives): asked what the money buys (deleveraging, no going-concern language, ~$186M cash), and with ~31% of shares short cut the financing overhang from -0.8 to -0.6.
Core table (lands inside what the company already told the market): gross-margin step-up was telegraphed on the Q2 call, so it moves from +0.5 to +0.3.
Lesson 6: revenue bar confirmed by guide plus two agreeing estimates (Benzinga, Earnings Whispers); EPS bar is single-source, so nothing is sized on an EPS beat beyond the one-off finding.
Positioning and the US/foodservice findings were left unchanged; abs_move_pct and p_up unchanged.
